content.translation: When we were living in Rochester, I would oftentimes be in a sad mood. So` one day I drive over to visit Nashua. Wanting to surprise them` I don't tell anyone on purpose that I am coming. So` when I arrive late at night` noone is expecting me. And Cri sees me outside the door like a poor little lamb that needs rescuing, and called me Urinyang. Hence my name is Urinyang.
